rules: Use English captions with a natural topic phrase early; first 125 characters is a practical drafting target, not a guaranteed truncation boundary.

Keep an accurate AI-avatar disclosure on every platform; do not say avatar of me unless the selected presenter actually represents Hammad.

Facebook captions should describe the reel and avoid excessive hashtags or engagement bait. Original recordings and graphics fit Meta’s preference for original content.
Use accessibility text to describe actual visuals, not keyword stuffing. Reel upload paths may not expose custom alt text.
